_note: Site-wide copy: identity, services, process, contact. TCRG is never called a "firm" or a paid service.
name: Tufts Capital Research Group
tagline: Pro bono market due diligence for institutional investors.
summary: TCRG is a student-run group at Tufts University. Each semester, our teams produce bespoke market due diligence for private equity firms, endowments and investment advisors, on a vertical the client chooses.
origin: TCRG began in Fall 2023 as the Tufts Investment Club's PE/VC Research Group and became the independently run Tufts Capital Research Group in Spring 2026, founded by Mathis Weber and Otto Laakso.
whatWeDo: Clients choose the vertical. Often it is a space they are weighing for an upcoming fund, or a thesis no one on their team has had time to pursue.
deliverable: A 60+ page read-deck built on secondary research and expert interviews, delivered over a roughly 11-week, semester-long engagement and closing with a final presentation to the client.

services.title: Comprehensive diligence
services.body: The full picture of a market: its value chain, technology, regulation and competitive landscape.

services.title: Expert insights
services.body: Calls with industry experts that test what secondary research alone can't settle.

services.title: Investment recommendations
services.body: High-potential strategies, potential acquisition targets and the risks to weigh.

process.title: Scoping
process.body: The client chooses the vertical, and together we set the questions the work must answer.

process.title: Research
process.body: Analysts build the secondary base: market structure, value chain, technology, regulation and key players.

process.title: Expert calls
process.body: Conversations with industry experts test our assumptions and fill gaps published sources leave open.

process.title: Synthesis
process.body: Findings are distilled into a 60+ page read-deck with a clear point of view.

process.title: Final presentation
process.body: The team presents its conclusions and recommendations to the client at the end of the engagement.

contact._note: Investor contact address, used as a mailto: link by ContactCta and in the home page's structured data.

items.q: Is TCRG the same group as the Tufts Investment Club's PE/VC Research Group?
items.a: Yes. The PE/VC Research Group started within the Tufts Investment Club in Fall 2023. In Spring 2026 it became the Tufts Capital Research Group.

items.q: Is TCRG still part of the Tufts Investment Club?
items.a: No. Since Spring 2026, TCRG has been run independently, with its own executive board.
